name: Lock Upp
description: Lockupp is a 24*7 captive reality show which has 16 celebrities locked inside the queen’s jail for 72 days. Who will survive the badass jail and play atyachaari khel?

videos.title: Badass Jailer Kangana Ke 13 Qaidi
videos.overview: Kangana Ranaut rakes the stage to talk about the show and the concept. She says that in her jail, it would not matter if the contestant is a star kid, influential politician or a famous business person – all that matters is the person needs to be controversial. Kangana also introduces the media people who will screen the Lock Upp contestants and put them up on a media trial. She then introduces the Lock Upp contestant.

videos.title: Day 1 - Aaj Kaun Hoga Nominate?
videos.overview: In the first nominations, The inmates nominate any two other inmates. Payal Rohatgi and Anjali Arora seem to be distraught by the lack of amenities given inside the house. They put forward their dissent and urge the jailer to give them at least the necessities. Payal puts forward the issue that the house has no access to sunlight or any form of the external environment. She explains, on camera, how she has been to a real Lock Upp and even there the environment is friendly with the view of trees and sunlight.

videos.title: Day 2 - Ab Qaidi Layenge Kranti
videos.overview: The contestants stage a protest and decide to go on a hunger strike if they are not provided with the basic amenities in the house. Babita requests the jailer to provide her with warm water as she has an issue with her legs and needs it for physio. Nisha Rawal, Sara Khan, Saisha, and others complain that they are not provided with their innerwear. Poonam Pandey complained of not having enough food supply as she needs her energy for her low BP. Even Anjali Arora complains of not having her makeup sent. To this, Munawar Farouqi comments that they are all locked up in jail and not a five-star hotel where all their whims and fancies will be catered to. Will the jailer take action against the contestants' mutiny?

videos.title: Day 3 - Jail Mein Jhagada
videos.overview: The day begins with the noisy alarm from the jailer which makes the inmates wake up in frustration. Later, in the day the contestants discuss the task that took place on the previous day. Poonam Pandey, Nisha Rawal, and Saisha also discuss their controversies which made them a part of the show. Poonam and Nisha talk about their abusive relationships and the consequences that they had to face for it while Saisha talks about the various unsolicited advice that was given to her before she undertook the gender reconstruction surgery. Later, the jailer announces that since the right block had won the task on the previous day they will be given all the things they had asked for. Everything rejoices to hear this and rushes to get their belongings. However, Payal had asked for sunlight which does not seem to be in sight yet.

videos.title: Day 4 - Kya Yeh Ek Tarfa Pyaar Hai?
videos.overview: Sara wakes up to find the heart that Shivam made for her in the night. She tells him that she had seen it in the night as well and compliments him. Shivam continues to flirt with Sara which makes her think that he is putting up an act and that he has been told to play a certain part. This upsets Shivam and he breaks down crying. Karan, Saisha, and others come to console him but he cries inconsolably. Sara also tries to calm him down and apologizes for assuming that he is putting up an act. Shivam tells her that he is like that and he wears his heart on his sleeve. Sara tells everyone that she finds it a little childish that Shivam says he has fallen in love with her in just 2 days. Where is this relationship headed? Will this remain a one-sided love or will Sara cave in and develop feelings for Shivam?

videos.title: Day 5 - Badass Jail Ka Badass Jailor
videos.overview: The jailer Karan Kundra is in jail and he had a word with the contestants and try to explain to them that it's badass jail so they need to survive like this only. Where contestants discuss yesterday's task. Where jailer called Sara in a jhol ghar and he offered favorite food options to Sara where she got emotional but at last he made her week by showing her mother and she wanted to meet her. But for this repercussion will be faced by the other contestants. Munawar talks about his jail experience and what problems he faced.

videos.title: Day 6 - Queen Ne Li Sabki Class
videos.overview: Where queen Kangana Ranaut talks about the reality of the jail what they need to face and tries to show them the reality of Lock Upp. A group discussion has been held yesterday where contestants talk about their secrets and got emotional. While the queen has scolded everyone that it's a jail, not some luxurious resort. Where they need to stop complaining and live like that. A task has been given to nominated contestants. Who will be nominated this week?

videos.title: Day 7 - Who revealed Their secrets?
videos.overview: The queen grills the contestants and tries to show the reality of this badass jail. Where nominated contents Swami, Anjali, and Siddharth are ordered to go to the benakab zone. While they need to confess their secret in front of the public and save themselves from nomination. Where Anjali reveals his secret and saved her from nomination. Where the queen questions Siddharth about his inactiveness post fighting with Shivam. Swami has been evicted from the show and said goodbye to the teammates.

videos.title: Day 8 - Akal Badi Ya Brains
videos.overview: The drama begins with a day. Saisha tells their team that doesn't trust the red team as they cheat with them. Sara cleared Shivam it's only friendship nothing else which will be interesting to watch that how deep this friendship will go? Kaidis are allocated with a task where they need to answer a few questions. The team which will give the right answer needs to lift the least weight. Watch Lock Upp on MX Player which team will win the game?

videos.title: Day 9 - Kisko Milegi Rasoi Ki chabhi
videos.overview: Where punishment is over for Siddharth, Saisha, and Shivam. The kaidis got the task from the jailer to get the keys to the kitchen. So which team will win the keys of the kitchen and rule. The contestants need to take two names from the charge sheet and for a twist, they need to take the name from their team. Where they got triggered by teammates' sentiments. Watch which contestant will be nominated for this week?

videos.title: Day 10 - Lock Upp Main Manaya Women's Day
videos.overview: Women's day has been celebrated in jail where kaidis welcomes the acid attack survivor women as the guests. Poonam got the secret task from the jailer against the blue team and she successfully did the task but she is disqualified. Why Poonam has been disqualified from the secret task?

videos.title: Day 11 - Ab Kya Sab Bhookhe Marenge
videos.overview: In the morning drama, begins between the teams that which team will cook the food. Where Payal has a heated conversation with Sara and Shivam because of the food she cooked last night. Where jailor Karan Kundara is back in the jail and taking the kaidis for a task where they secretly take each team to the location. Where they will play a task "Uchi Hai Building". Which team will win the task and get the immunity for jhol ghar?

videos.title: Day 12 - Koun Hoga Kurbaan?
videos.overview: Where inmates got the task to make 40 flower garlands. While orange team win the game and got the gift which they are eagerly waiting for a long time. Meanwhile, Saisha tells the jailor that she feel demotivated in yesterday's game. Where jailor talks to kaidis about their behavior. Karan asked Saisha to confess her feelings. Munawar is called to jhol ghar where jailor gives a choice to Munawar which make him puzzled? What he will choose between the sister letter or teammates?

videos.overview: Fifteen inmates enter a new-age jail where they must confront unflattering labels, shocking secrets and harsh criticism from each other.

videos.title: Tagged and Targeted
videos.overview: A new status system forces inmates to deal with harsh labels, manage shared resources and compete in a group challenge that sparks emotional meltdowns.

videos.title: The Jailor’s Bargain
videos.overview: Akanksha and Harshad's strategy sparks a heated debate. Five inmates have a chance to reveal another's secret for safety, leaving some in fear.

videos.title: The First Chargesheet
videos.overview: Jailer Farah's first chargesheet puts five inmates at risk while tensions rise between Ram and Akanksha. Sufi has a vulnerable moment.

videos.title: Survive the Crackdown
videos.overview: Crackdown brings a high-stakes task, giving the inmates one last chance to secure themselves. Shreya clashes with Dheeraj and Pamela.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: The inmates face hard truths as Kangana Ranaut voices public critiques. An overheard secret leads to betrayal, while the journey ends for one inmate.

videos.title: Hungry for More
videos.overview: Hunger grips the inmates as their funds run dry. Sunita and Ram revolt against the game's tactics. A diamond hunt offers a way to secure more food.

videos.title: The Bid and The Bomb
videos.overview: Save their friends — or funds for food? As the inmates bid for safety, a new arrival stirs things up, threatening to split the prison wide open.

videos.title: Greed v/s Need
videos.overview: Shreya's behavior leaves Shivangi shaken, sparking an unexpected reaction from Harshad. Dynamics shift as inmates scramble to win special advantages.

videos.title: Love and War
videos.overview: A stark split in the jail creates two warring factions with no middle ground. A heated clash between Akanksha Chaudhary and Shreya rattles everyone.

videos.title: The Visitor
videos.overview: A special guest's visit stirs an emotional reckoning for Akanksha Chamola. The inmates pick sides as the jail's divisions grow deeper.

videos.title: The Storm Arrives
videos.overview: It's Judgement Day, and the jailers aren't holding back in their critiques. As inmates fight to stay, a shocking secret is revealed and two go home.

videos.title: Ep. 13 - Control or Chaos
videos.overview: A reshuffling forces new cellmates — a controller and a dependent — to work together, but the challenge soon throws the prison into chaos.

videos.title: Ep. 14 - The Price of Control
videos.overview: Friends become rivals as a new dynamic tears bonds apart, and the stakes rise when a task puts the dependent's darkest secret in the controller's hands.

videos.title: Ep. 15 - Powers, Secrets, Termination
videos.overview: Friendship erodes in the jail and a new secret is revealed. A shocking midweek Judgement Day decision sends two inmates home.

videos.title: Ep. 16 - Nothing stays fun
videos.overview: Varun makes a surprising discovery in the secret room. Pamala's talk show brings out hidden talents and new tension among the inmates.

videos.title: Ep. 17 -  Messy Business
videos.overview: Chaos reigns in the crackdown as controllers attempt to stack tile towers, but frustrations and sabotage take over. Who will crack under the pressure?

videos.title: Shock and Terminate
videos.overview: A stunning Judgement Day sees one inmate returning and another leaving. Five controllers fight for the power to eliminate.

videos.title: Gang Up
videos.overview: Under new leaders, two gangs battle for the upper hand in high-stakes challenges, where the losers face a test of their survival skills.

videos.title: The Struggle Is Real
videos.overview: The inmates compete for powers that decide if they live in comfort or scramble for resources. Dheeraj gets a warning and Shilpa's antics stir trouble.

videos.title: Discarded
videos.overview: Conflict between teams intensifies as rebellion grows in the jail. Three inmates are left without a gang, but a new leader may soon change that.

videos.title: The New Force
videos.overview: An agent of disruption arrives — as Apoorva separates the sincere from the pretenders, a new gang holds the power to change the rules.

videos.title: The Temperature Rises
videos.overview: Emotions run high as Shivangi stands her ground and Apoorva holds a hard line. Shilpa's helping hand leads to tears and turmoil.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Five inmates face Judgement Day as Uorfi Javed and Hina Khan interrogate secrets and deception, trying to uncover the truth behind their words.
